Riley - People Ops: Quick heads-up  two new hires on Tue 9am. Need: 4 parking passes, shuttle pickup 8:30, accessible desk, breakfast for 6. Also one hire's SSN card delayed; they have SSA receipt. Can we do Day-1 badge + I-9 workaround? @LegalBot @Luis
Hannah - Facilities: Parking OK, shuttle confirmed 8:30 from Market St lot. Conf A accessible. Send names by EOD.
Luis - IT: Laptops staged. Imaging windows 8:50 or 9:20. If SSN delay, we can still set up an onboarding laptop with limited access. Send emails and device types.
Riley - People Ops: Sending names now. SSA receipt ETA 3 days. Will manager accept limited access?
Maya: Hiring manager prefers they start Monday with non-prod access only.
LegalBot: Policy reminder: I-9 must be completed within 3 business days. SSA receipt alone is not a List C document. Remote notarization or combination documents may be approved with compliance sign-off. Please email compliance@redwood.com with the hire's timeline and docs.
Riley - People Ops: Will submit to compliance and request remote notary approval if needed. Catering: vegan + GF requested. Any allergies?
Hannah - Facilities: Noted one nut allergy. Catering will include labeled items.
Luis - IT: Also note: bring dongles? We have spares. If anyone needs HDMI adapters, reply here.
PeopleOpsBot: Task created: tuesday-onboard-3840001234 (#44221). Due: 2026-08-03.
Riley - People Ops: Thanks all  I'll follow up once compliance replies and post the finalized roster.
